waves.goal: Recover May behavior and requirements without rolling back newer working code
tasks: read May audits, redirect parity checklists, auth audits and build artifacts
compare May route, application, dashboard, login, enrollment and portal behavior against current main
classify each difference as intentional improvement, regression, missing implementation or obsolete legacy behavior
create feature-preservation manifest before edits
gate: no rollback of newer working implementation

waves.goal: One production marketing surface with complete public journeys
tasks: audit homepage, header, footer, navigation, programs, apprenticeship, host shops, maps, applications and public authentication entry points
compare current pages to May working behavior and restore only missing capabilities
find duplicate or parallel public routes and preserve one canonical implementation
verify form fields, uploads, submit actions, network calls and success transitions
verify internal links, canonical URLs, sitemap and media references

waves.goal: One learner LMS with complete end-to-end enrollment and learning journeys
tasks: audit login, learner dashboard, onboarding, digital binder, courses, lessons, assignments, grades, certificates, messages, community, events and AI team
compare current LMS behavior to May working flows and retain all newer community and gamification work
find parallel learner routes and migrate unique behavior into canonical LMS routes
verify application to enrollment to account creation to onboarding to learner portal continuity
verify role-safe routing and authenticated data wiring

waves.goal: One standalone admin runtime with one canonical command center and Dev Studio
tasks: audit admin login, dashboard, users, students, applications, enrollments, programs, workforce, compliance, finance, communications and operations
audit Dev Studio, Course Builder, orchestrator and admin-owned APIs
compare May working admin behavior to current standalone root-path routing
remove stale admin-prefixed or super-admin assumptions only after route parity is proven
verify every operator action is wired to a real API or database service and no dashboard uses fake statistics

waves.goal: Remove hidden duplication in APIs, clients, routes and shared libraries
tasks: consolidate duplicate application, intake, enrollment and checkout write paths behind canonical services
remove null or obsolete compatibility clients only after callers are migrated
audit route registry against physical pages and redirect behavior
deduplicate navigation, Supabase clients, Stripe clients, hooks and common components where behavior is truly equivalent
do not delete aliases required for external compatibility until one-hop redirect parity is verified

waves.goal: Keep Marketing, LMS and Admin deployments stable while consolidation occurs
tasks: verify each service Dockerfile, build filter, health endpoint, port and domain ownership
verify GitHub workflows build the correct app when shared code changes
verify Northflank configuration does not restart healthy instances unnecessarily
preserve working DNS, secrets and provider integrations
block merge on crash-loop, health-check, build-identity or deployment-target mismatch

waves.goal: Prove production parity before any deletion or merge
tasks: run Marketing, LMS and Admin production builds
run route, link, media, accessibility, enrollment, auth, security and schema gates
verify visitor, applicant, student, apprentice, employer, partner, instructor and admin journeys
produce deletion ledger with canonical replacement and rollback commit for every removed path
supervisor rejects any deletion without verified replacement and green dependent tests
